channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Paolo Banchero | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Paolo Banchero from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Kendrick Perkins on Paolo Banchero
item.description:
Kendrick Perkins:

“The Orlando Magic. You fired the coach. They're not going to have a run like they expecting. You got a new head coach. They're going to move on from Paolo Banchero eventually. He will be the first All-Star, All-NBA player traded.”

Kendrick Perkins on Paolo Banchero, Aug 28, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Charlie Villanueva on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Paolo Banchero
item.description:
During the To the Baha podcast, Villanueva stated that Giannis will be a part of the Orlando Magic next season, while in return the Bucks will receive Orlando’s All-Star forward.

“You know I'm involved in the Milwaukee Bucks situation, I'm involved with organization somehow, someway. You know where he's going? Orlando Magic. Remember I said that. Giannis is going to the Orlando Magic. Paolo (Banchero), have a good night,”

Charlie Villanueva on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Paolo Banchero, Apr 17, 2026. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Jamahl Mosley on Franz Wagner, Paolo Banchero
item.description:
Bobby Manning:Jamahl Mosley on Franz Wagner/Paolo Banchero:

“It's a big time opportunity for all of our guys, to experience this level of competition... there's levels to it ... it's very good for this group to experience this in this environment.”

Jamahl Mosley on Franz Wagner, Paolo Banchero, Apr 20, 2025. Source: Twitter @RealBobManning.

item.title: Jayson Tatum on Paolo Banchero
item.description:
Tatum on facing Banchero:

“He’s trying to lead his team in a playoff series and figure out ways to win and I’m trying to do the same. Shifting your mindset to … no friends out there.”

Jayson Tatum on Paolo Banchero, Apr 16, 2025. Source: Twitter @RealBobManning.

item.title: Blake Griffin on Paolo Banchero
item.description:
Gary Washburn:Blake Griffin on Paolo Banchero:

“People said this about me when I was coming in (the NBA) but once he truly learns the NBA's in and outs, he's going to be scary. He didn't back down from anybody. He'll have ups and downs but he's going to be fine. He'll be good.”

Blake Griffin on Paolo Banchero, Oct 23, 2022. Source: Twitter @GwashburnGlobe.

item.title: Jamahl Mosley on Paolo Banchero
item.description:
Bobby Manning:Jamahl Mosley on Paolo Banchero:

“Basketball IQ and selflessness…he’s such a great young player already in the way he sees the game …he’s reading and understanding … it’s extremely unique, but that’s what makes him him.”

Jamahl Mosley on Paolo Banchero, Oct 22, 2022. Source: Twitter @RealBobManning.

item.title: Paul George on Dejounte Murray, Paolo Banchero
item.description:
“Good entertainment, that Orlando-Atlanta matchup, that Paolo [Banchero], Dejounte [Murray] sh*t. But they from the same city, so pretty sure it's all for the love of the game.”

Paul George on Dejounte Murray, Paolo Banchero, Aug 10, 2022. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Cole Anthony on Paolo Banchero
item.description:
Anthony knows what Banchero represents to an organization -- and city -- that hasn't been nationally relevant to the league since Dwight Howard left town in 2012.

“I've been in the gym with [Banchero] a little bit already, seeing him out here, just doing what he does,”

Cole Anthony on Paolo Banchero, Jul 26, 2022. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Tari Eason on Paolo Banchero
item.description:
David Hardisty:Tari Eason on possibly playing with Seattle guys KPJ and Paolo Banchero:

“That would be really dope. I've known Paolo since high school and Kevin since high school. I have a pretty good relationship with Paolo. We roomed together at Pangos.”

Tari Eason on Paolo Banchero, Jun 20, 2022. Source: Twitter @clutchfans.

item.title: Charles Barkley on Paolo Banchero
item.description:
“Coming in, I said, 'Yo' man, there are two or three different guys you can take with the No. 1 pick in the draft.' Blah, blah, blah, blah, blah — hell no. You taking this dude (points to Banchero picture) right here.”

Charles Barkley on Paolo Banchero, Mar 27, 2022. Source: Montgomery Advertiser.
